lede: Minnesota carries the stronger underlying team rating — -2.0 against -7.8, a 5.8-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Minnesota -27.9 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Minnesota winning 96% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 41% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.

underdog.heading: Why Akron can keep it close
bullets: Kicking: Akron 56.4 (#36 of 101) vs Minnesota 55.0 (#71 of 101) — 35 places on the national board.
The outcome range is 15.5 points wide at one sigma — p10 +3.9 to p90 +48.9 for Minnesota, so a projection of +27.9 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 6%.
